# iRepair

> iRepair is a mobile phone repair shop in G-11 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan. It repairs phones of all major brands and also builds websites and mobile apps.

## Business facts
- Name: iRepair
- Address: Shop 12, Main Market, G-11 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan
- Phone and WhatsApp: +92 317 1991742
- Email: hello@irepair.pk
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 9 pm. Closed Sunday.
- Service area: Islamabad and Rawalpindi

## Services
- Screen replacement: Cracked glass, dead touch or lines on the display, fixed with quality screens for all major phone models.
- Battery and charging repair: Battery replacement and charging port repair for phones that drain fast, swell or will not charge.
- PIN and passcode removal: Pattern, PIN and FRP removal on supported phone models for the rightful owner.
- Phone software repair: Fixes for hanging phones, boot loops, update failures and viruses.
- Phone hardware and board repair: Water damage recovery, no-power faults and board-level repair.
- Phone accessories, buy and sell: Chargers, cases, screen glass and earbuds, plus buying and selling used phones.
- Website building: Fast, mobile-friendly websites for shops, businesses and personal brands.
- Mobile app development: Custom Android and iOS apps for businesses.
- Logo and branding design: Logo design and a simple brand kit for shop signs, social pages and websites.
- Phone data backup and transfer: Safe phone-to-phone data transfer, cloud and local backup, and WhatsApp chat transfer.
